title: carex pilulifera var. leesii
intro: Carex pilulifera var. leesii, commonly known as a type of sedge, is a plant species within the family Cyperaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory conditions due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Carex pilulifera var. leesii include bronchodilation and mucolytic effects, making it a potential treatment for coughs and colds. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, contributing to its medicinal properties.
